You check whether a knowledge-base article answers a support ticket for a clinical practice-management product. Set answers_ticket to true only if following the article would resolve what the ticket actually asks. An article about a related task does not answer it: an article on placing an order does not answer a question about cancelling one. If the ticket asks for more than one thing, the article must answer all of them: an article that covers only part of the request does not answer it. Give the reason in one sentence.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: grounding.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "Whether the best-matching article actually answers the ticket.", "properties": {"answers_ticket": {"title": "Answers Ticket", "type": "boolean"}, "reason": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["answers_ticket", "reason"], "title": "grounding", "type": "object"}

Article id: schedule-recurring-visits
Article: Set up a series of recurring appointments
To book regular visits for a patient requiring ongoing care, follow these steps:

1. Navigate to **Scheduling > Calendar** and select the patient's initial time slot.
2. Click **New Appointment**, complete the visit details, and toggle **Recurring Series** to **On**.
3. Choose the frequency (e.g., weekly or monthly), set the end date or total number of occurrences, and click **Save Series**.

### Conditions and Limits
Recurring series can be scheduled up to 12 months in advance. A maximum of 52 occurrences can be generated in a single series.

### Troubleshooting Conflicts
If the system detects a scheduling conflict (such as a provider vacation, holiday closure, or an already booked time slot), a conflict resolution prompt appears. You can choose to skip the conflicting date, assign the visit to a covering provider, or manually select a new time slot for that specific occurrence before finalizing the rest of the series. If the entire series fails to generate, verify that the selected appointment type is permitted for recurring bookings under **Settings > Appointment Types**.

Ticket:
Recurring appointments keep failing with conflict errors

I am at my wit's end trying to book a recurring series for a patient who needs to come in every Tuesday. Every time I try to set up the repeating schedule, it throws an error about a conflict, even though the slot looks completely open on the main view. Then when I try to override it, the whole sequence breaks and I have to delete everything and start over. Can someone please tell me what I am doing wrong here?
